attchmntText: Shiva Texyarn Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shiva Texyarn Limited approved its Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026 at a Board meeting held on 12.11.2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board. Statutory Auditors M/s. VKS Aiyer & Co. issued a Limited Review Report. The company is primarily engaged in manufacturing textile and related products. Consolidated figures include the associate company L.K. Distributors Private Limited. Standalone total assets as at 30.09.2026 were 29,769.93 Lakhs. Consolidated total assets were 29,927.34 Lakhs. Standalone cash and cash equivalents were 669.42 Lakhs. Consolidated cash and cash equivalents were 669.42 Lakhs. The meeting commenced at 11.30 A.M. and concluded at 1.29 P.M.

attchmntText: Shiva Texyarn Limited has informed the Exchange regarding resignation of Mr G K Raman, President - Strategic Affairs, Senior Management Personnel of the company w.e.f. October 31, 2026.
Shiva Texyarn Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
